Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		foundLoanTerms: Set(LoanTerm) = LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(lt|lt.ItemID = itemid and
		lt.Content = content)
	precondition:
		itemid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		content.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let newLoanTerm: LoanTerm in
		newLoanTerm.oclIsNew() and
		foundLoanTerms.isEmpty() = true and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLoanTerm) and
		newLoanTerm.ItemID = itemid and
		newLoanTerm.Content = content and
		result = true or
		foundLoanTerms.isEmpty() = false and
		result = true
}
